notes.title: Version 0.16.0 (pre-release)
notes.notes:
Hello! Cole here. I just created a new pre-release build of Bludgeon with the recent changes I've been working on.

[h2]Change Log[/h2]
In this version, I've been working on making the menus look nicer, and also making them easier to navigate. The menu options were mostly just plain text before, but now they have some animated buttons and other added graphics. The selected option is also highlighted more clearly, so it's easier to tell what you're doing.

[h2]Preview[/h2]
Here's a GIF showing what the menus look like now. I hope you like them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222858/f35ab4ac61dc9c3bb1c802ddfcfaf9d2622ef221.gif[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.15.0 (pre-release)
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! Cole here. I just created a new pre-release build of Bludgeon with the recent changes I've been working on. The main thing for this version is some new characters to choose from.

[h2]Change Log[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added 3 more characters: the Myconid, the Werecat, and the Lich.
[*]Touched up some of the artwork in the menus.
[*]Fixed a bug where, in a draw, a point was assigned to one of the players.
[*]Fixed a sorting layer issue when characters overlapped.
[/list]

[h2]Preview[/h2]
Here's a preview of the current cast of characters. I've really been enjoying imagining what kinds of creatures inhabit the world of Bludgeon. I hope you enjoy them as well!
